summary: First full E2E run of MarkImagem Rádio Web. Backend: 42 pytest cases (auth/cookies/CORS/lockout, role isolation, plans, trial + MP-not-configured checkout, music upload/ZIP/duplicate/reject/playlist order, ads create/TTS/publish/agendado/expiry/maintenance, media 403 isolation + Range 206, radio engine interleave every_n=1 and ads_paused, client request -> admin convert, edit text clears audio + version, voice consent/upload/clone-not-configured/voice test, Claude SSE copy, settings masking, webhook 401, cron 401/200, all 11 reports + CSV). Found and FIXED 2 real 500 bugs (login lockout tz compare, TTS generate for client ads). After fixes 42/42 pass. Frontend: landing plans, register with LGPD, trial checkout, client big player Play/Pause with title + NO AR badge + mini player, request dialog -> admin Solicitações convert, AI copy fills textarea, voice page (consent gating, not-configured alert, voice test audio), settings masked token, reports CSV download, mobile 390px client player + admin sidebar — all working.

critical.issue: 6th attempt after 5 failures returned 500 instead of 429: Mongo returns naive datetime for locked_until compared with aware now(). FIXED by AsyncIOMotorClient(..., tz_aware=True) in core.py

500 'async_generator object is not iterable' for any ad with business_id (sum(... async for ...) in TTS monthly quota check). Only institutional ads worked. FIXED in routes_ads.py by using await find().to_list()

minor.issue: A batch where all files are duplicates still creates a new package (accepted=0) containing the existing track ids and rebuilds the playlist, moving old duplicate tracks to the front ('newest package first' gets polluted).
Lockout counter is not reset when locked_until expires: after the 15 min window one more wrong password re-locks immediately (count stays >=5).
Range requests load the entire file into memory and LRU cache holds 40 full files (up to ~1.2GB with 30MB MP3s). Consider streaming/smaller cache.
Seeded plans are not published, so landing/subscription shows no plans unless admin publishes one (after test cleanup the public list is empty).

design_issues.screen: Ad editor / client request dialog / reports
issues: Native browser date/time inputs (show mm/dd/yyyy, US format) instead of shadcn Calendar/date picker in pt-BR (ad-start-date-input, ad-end-date-input, ad-request-start-input, ad-request-end-input, hour inputs)
Native <select> elements used instead of shadcn Select (styling inconsistent with dark theme)
'Período' column renders '— – —' when no dates; show a single '—'
Console a11y warning: DialogContent without DialogTitle (Radix) on one of the dialogs

rca of the issue: Lockout 500: login_attempts.locked_until stored as aware datetime, read back naive by Motor (tz_aware default False) -> TypeError comparing with datetime.now(timezone.utc). TTS 500: `sum(u['chars'] async for u in cursor)` builds an async generator which sum() cannot iterate; only reached when ad has business_id, so institutional ad manual test missed it.
